name: Bag BOM
description: Offline webcam label scanning and component selection for InteractiveHtmlBom.
description_full: Scan supported DigiKey, LCSC, Mouser, Newark and Arrow QR / Data Matrix / PDF417 labels to automatically highlight matching components in InteractiveHtmlBom. Farnell and element14 product URL QR codes are also supported. Exact MPN or supplier identifiers must be exported in the BOM. Decoding and optional OCR run locally. Experimental release; requires InteractiveHtmlBom separately. Apache-2.0.
